Bay: a small dark stop at each spring of every light's casing, on its outer edge (T-2457)

Entrance: the posts broad plain piers, 0.22 m across (T-2425)

Rendered, the roof's ends, posts, quatrefoils, spring, crown and roof lie within 4 px of the print, the tower's sills, points, cornice and spire within 1 px

Entrance: a pale gabled shape over the door's south leaf, 686-757 px across and 622-650 px high, identified by T-2520 as a glazed transom over the leaves: the leaves' lights' own tone in a porch otherwise black, starting on the south jamb, on a dark bar over the head. Built as a 0.12 m bar and one light under a low gable, 0.17 m at the jambs and 0.39 m at the middle: rendered, its south slope lies within 1 px of the print's (631, 627 and 623 px at 700, 710 and 720 px), its foot and apex 4 px high, and the apex at the door's middle, 10 px north of the print's; the glass's dark north part (what it reflects) is not modelled

Tower: the upper stage is smooth, with no course line on its three street faces from the porch roof to the cornice, under a frieze only 0.12 m deep (the print's one line across each face at 300 px); over each light a faint incised figure about 0.23 by 0.32 m (6.34-6.66 m through the camera T-2523 re-solved), built as an incised trefoil, one lobe up, its foot on the light's casing band; the model's stage was clapboarded under the kit's 0.4 m frieze (T-2521)

Tower: each light's casing is carried round its pointed head as an arched band, the smooth face round it, with no head board or drip cap, where the model's lights stood in square-headed casings (T-2521)

Fence: two gate piers either side of an open gateway, 0.9 m clear at s 0.46 and 1.76 m, each a square shaft on a plinth under a hollow cap pierced in every face with an inverted heart, the north pier's iron finial a spike through a ring, the south's a plain spike; and thin iron bars 0.244 m apart on a pale base along the street line, 0.58 m to their rail (T-2456)

Fence: each cap is the shaft's breadth at its top (57 px, 0.36 m, with its eave) and its lower corners flare out like a hood over the heart, a quarter-sine from 1.36 m to 0.40 m across at 1.215 m (63 px), then rounded back in to the shaft by 1.17 m; the model's cap was a plain box 0.40 m across; those readings stand in the frame of the camera T-2423 solved, and through the one T-2523 re-solved the whole fence draws smaller than the print's, which T-2524 re-reads (T-2521)

Fence: south of the south pier, read again at 3x (T-2521), the print's 'pale block' is the lawn, in the tone of the lawn between the bars north of the gateway (180-200 against 160-200) under a hedge line at 946 px; a bar stands at 68-70 px hard by the plinth, dark down to the base, and the base runs on under it to the frame, so it is the barred run continuing, as the model builds it; the pale dash at 918 px over those same 20 px stands where the model's own top rail does (925 px), and the 7 px between them falls to the fence's heights T-2524 re-reads

South of the gable the print shows a two-storey block with a hipped roof, a pale stack and a two-light window over a door: the register's 'separate lower wing' or the neighbour, not yet identified; the model shows the gable range's south flank and projection there
Colour of every surface: the print is a monochrome halftone
